title: Browse a bay’s compatible module types
steps: Inspect the loaded Module Types catalog and its manufacturer/model rows.
Follow Module Bay Types in Devices, open SFP28 transceiver bay, and wait for its compatible types to load.
Review the compatible rows and use the Manufacturer and Module Type headings to examine their ordering.
Inspect Per Page, choose 25, and browse the first and next pages of compatible types.
Scroll down to inspect the lower Module Bays section.
Return to page 1 and scroll up to the bay heading and beginning of the compatible collection.

video_guide.summary: Browse manufacturer-labeled compatible types, change column ordering, and inspect both bounded pages and the lower bay section.

chapters.note: The catalog shows separate Cisco and Generic rows for SFP-25G-SR-C.

chapters.label: Follow Module Bay Types in Devices.

chapters.note: Compatible Module Types is a separate table with Module Type and Manufacturer columns, including Cisco and Generic SFP-25G-SR-C rows.
Manufacturer has a downward arrow; the visible first rows show Cisco, Cisco, then Generic.

chapters.label: Activate Manufacturer again to reverse the ordering.

chapters.note: Manufacturer has an upward arrow, and the first visible rows now show Generic.
Module Type has a downward arrow. The two SFP-25G-SR-C rows appear together with Cisco and Generic manufacturer labels.

chapters.label: Use Per Page to choose 25 items.

chapters.note: Page 1 is selected, with page 2 available and the range Showing 1–25 of 38 above Module Bays.

chapters.label: Open page 2 of the compatible types.
Scroll down to the page range and Module Bays section.

chapters.note: Page 2 is selected with Showing 26–38 of 38. Module Bays is visible below and says No module bays found.

chapters.label: Return to page 1 and scroll up to the bay heading.

chapters.note: The bay heading and the first compatible rows are visible again, including both SFP-25G-SR-C manufacturer associations.
